label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param flows to host variable, which is used in connectHttpByHostname() making outbound HTTP connection. While isNonPublicAddress() check exists, it only validates resolved IP at one point and does not prevent DNS rebinding, IPv6 bypasses, or protocol-based SSRF attacks. Resolved sink value at line 44 is host = param (user input), which remains attacker-controllable throughout the data flow.

evidence.note: User param assigned to host, then connectHttpByHostname(host) creates URL with http:// + host and opens connection
connectHttpByHostname constructs URL from host parameter and calls openConnection().connect()
